verdict.rationale: Gitea's own docs claim a built-in package registry supporting 20+ formats (Cargo, npm, Maven, Docker/Container, NuGet, PyPI, RubyGems, Helm, Composer, Conda, Pub, Vagrant, etc.), directly matching the multi-format publish/consume story. No community evidence contradicts this specific feature, though no independent hands-on validation of the package registry is present.
